name: Amoxicillin
description: Broad-spectrum penicillin-class antibiotic for bacterial infections.
fda_indications: Bacterial infections of the respiratory tract, ear, nose, throat.
how_to_use: Take one capsule every 8 hours until finished.

name: Ventolin HFA
description: Fast-acting bronchodilator rescue inhaler that relaxes airway muscles.
fda_indications: Acute relief of bronchospasm or prevention of exercise-induced bronchospasm.
how_to_use: 2 inhalations every 4 to 6 hours as needed.

name: Lexapro
description: Highly selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) with minimal drug interactions.
fda_indications: Generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) and major depressive disorder.
how_to_use: Take once daily in morning or evening.
